subject: Initial MAP: critical path canvas + acceptance slate
messages:
From: Ellen Park <ellen@waybridge.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@waybridge.ai
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: MAP template and proposed evaluation cadence

Hi Soojin,

Thanks for the demo yesterday — the team liked the latency benchmarks and the pricing sketch. We want to move from discovery into a short evaluation to validate cost-inference and latency on our core flows.

Can you share a standard Mutual Action Plan (MAP) you use for a 4–6 week pilot? Specifically:
- A timeline with milestones and decision gates
- Suggested acceptance criteria (latency, throughput, functional tests)
- Roles / owners on both sides (engineering, procurement, security)

We have a procurement review on Aug 10 and would like a draft MAP + acceptance slate to circulate internally by next week.

Ellen Park
Head of ML, Waybridge AI
ellen@waybridge.ai

P.S. CCing procurement for contract timing questions.

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Ellen Park <ellen@waybridge.ai>
Cc: procurement@waybridge.ai, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: MAP template and proposed evaluation cadence

Hi Ellen — great to hear feedback from your team. Attaching a lightweight critical-path canvas and a short acceptance-slate slide draft to help your procurement and engineering teams align. Link to editable doc: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2B_redwood_map_canvas_stub

High-level recommendation (tailored for Waybridge):
- Week 0 (prep): creds + test data access, account provisioning, security questionnaire answers
- Week 1: smoke tests + small sample latency run (engineer-to-engineer sync)
- Weeks 2–3: scale perf runs (concurrency/throughput) + quantization/latency tuning options
- Week 4: quality regression checks on representative prompts + acceptance run
- Decision gate (end Week 4): Go / iterate / stop with explicit pass/fail criteria

Acceptance slate (included): 1) P95 latency <= 350ms on our 512-token path, 2) end-to-end throughput >= X qps on reserved capacity, 3) semantic parity metric delta <= 6% vs baseline. We can tune thresholds once we see your sample traces.

Attachments: redwood_critical_path_canvas.gdoc, acceptance-slate-v1.gslides, security-reqs-checklist.pdf

Next steps I suggest:
1) You confirm the target SLA thresholds (latency/throughput/quality) for procurement circulation by Thu 23 Jul
2) We propose an engagement owner from your infra/ML team (name + email) so we can provision access
3) I'll ask Marissa to run a short kickoff with your CS/Eng team to lock the week0 checklist

Happy to jump on a 30-min call to walk through the canvas — I can do 11:00–12:00 PT Thu.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0192
